summary: Today's briefing highlights key legal rulings and significant retail earnings, reflecting ongoing regulatory developments and market responses in India.

bullets.text: Punjab and Haryana High Court mandates social media users receive a copy of takedown orders.
Bombay High Court requests State's response regarding mass detentions during anti-CEC protests.
Bajaj Finance reports a 29% YoY net profit increase to Rs 6,367 crore for Q2.
K-Beauty sales surged 200% and men's skincare by 78% as Gen Z reshapes Myntra's beauty offerings.
Retail firms report revenue growth amid margin pressures in Q2 results, highlighting cost management challenges.
